hero.title: Tells you what you need to know today — before you ask.
hero.lead: Dijital Asistan understands your email, calendar and open tasks, and prepares a short briefing for you every day.
hero.trust: iPhone and Android · Turkish and English · Never sends an email or changes your calendar without your approval.
hero.panelTitle: Every morning, only what you need to know, in six parts.
hero.panelFoot: Every item shows where it came from.

integrations.title: Works with the accounts you already use.
integrations.lead: Connect Gmail and Outlook email, Google, Outlook and Apple calendars, and Google Tasks and Microsoft To Do. Signing in and connecting accounts are separate: you can sign in with Apple and connect Gmail.
integrations.reassurance: Reads only what you allow. Remove a connection whenever you like.
integrations.planNote: Free: {mail, plural, one {# email account} other {# email accounts}} and {cal, plural, one {# calendar} other {# calendars}}. Pro: more than one.
integrations.planNoteFallback: The Free plan connects a limited number of accounts; Pro connects more than one.

connect.title: Connect your accounts
connect.body: Connect your email and calendar. At every step you see what is accessed and why.

analysis.title: See your first analysis
analysis.body: It reviews your last 72 hours: how many emails arrived, how many really matter, what's on your calendar and who is waiting for a reply.

daily.title: Get your briefing every day
daily.body: A short briefing is prepared at the time you choose. Notifications arrive only when they are worth it.

briefing.title: Start the day knowing what matters.
briefing.lead: Your briefing has six parts: {sections}. Every item shows where it came from.
briefing.free: The morning briefing is included in the free plan.
briefing.pro: Midday pulse, evening close and audio briefing are Pro. The midday pulse only arrives when something important changed since the morning.

mail.title: 83 emails. Only 4 really matter.
mail.sample: A sample day; numbers depend on your inbox.
mail.lead: It sorts incoming email into six groups: {categories}. You see the AI summary first; every decision shows its reason, and you can correct it with one tap.
mail.tones: Drafts replies in four tones: Short, Professional, Friendly, Detailed. You edit the draft; nothing is sent until you approve.
mail.inbox: Nothing is deleted or moved; your inbox stays as it is.
mail.pro: Smart follow-up and commitment tracking are Pro.

meeting.title: Never walk into a meeting unprepared.
meeting.lead: Before your meeting it gathers who you're meeting, your recent emails, open topics and promises on both sides on one page, and suggests three things to talk about.
meeting.summary: Read or listen to the “2-minute summary” before you go in.
meeting.after: When the meeting ends it asks “Anything you need to follow up on?”, turns what you say into a commitment proposal and asks for approval before saving.

planning.title: It doesn't just show your calendar. It understands it.
planning.lead: It spots conflicts, back-to-back meetings, meetings that need preparation and your free time. When it finds a gap, it suggests how to use it.
planning.example: “You're free tomorrow 14:00–16:30. I can place the proposal task there.”
planning.approval: Your calendar never changes without your approval.
planning.views: Day and week views bring your calendar, tasks and commitments together.

memory.title: Ask your digital life.
memory.lead: It finds the answer in your email, calendar and saved notes and shows its sources. It never invents what isn't in a source; if it doesn't know, it says so.

questions.q1: “What did Mehmet and I last talk about?”
questions.q2: “Which deadlines do I have this week?”
questions.q3: “What was the flight I booked last month?”

memory.pro: AI memory is Pro; it is limited to the retention period you choose.
memory.voice: You can also ask by voice. If something needs to be written or changed, it still asks for your approval first.

security.title: You're always in control.
security.lead: Dijital Asistan suggests; you decide. Every important action comes to the Approval Center with what will happen, why and where: Approve, Edit or Reject.
security.retentionChoice: You choose how long analysis results are kept: 30 days, 90 days, 1 year or until you delete them.
security.exportDelete: Export your data, or delete your history or account, whenever you want.
security.googleLine: Use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
security.rights: You can exercise your rights under KVKK and GDPR in the app's Privacy Center or on this site.

deletion.title: Delete your Dijital Asistan account and data
deletion.lead: Request deletion of your Dijital Asistan account and all its data here. We verify it's you with a 6-digit code sent to your email. To delete only your analysis history and keep the account, use the app.

inApp.title: The fastest way: in the app

steps.profile: Tap your profile picture at the top right.
steps.privacy: Choose Privacy & Security › Delete my account.
steps.confirm: Read what will be deleted and confirm.

inApp.historyOnly: History only: Privacy & Security › Delete analysis history.

flow.emailHelp: If you signed in with Apple and hid your email, your address ends in …@privaterelay.appleid.com.
flow.codeInfo: If an account exists for this address, we sent a 6-digit code. It's valid for 10 minutes.
flow.consequencesTitle: Your account will be permanently deleted.
flow.subscriptionReminder: Deleting your account doesn't cancel an App Store or Google Play subscription.
flow.microsoftReminder: If you connected a Microsoft account, also remove the permission at Microsoft.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.otpInvalid: The code couldn't be verified. Check it or request a new one.
errors.verifyNetwork: Your request couldn't be sent. Try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: The verification service can't be reached right now. Try again or delete in the app.

flow.lockedBody: For your security, this address can't be verified for 1 hour.
flow.doneBody: Your account and data are being deleted; this usually completes within 24 hours. We'll email {email} when it's done. The app on your phone is signed out.
flow.subscriptionActive: You have an active App Store or Google Play subscription. Deleting your account doesn't cancel it; cancel it to avoid charges.
flow.statusUnavailable: The status can't be retrieved right now. We'll email you the result.
flow.noScript: The web request needs JavaScript. You can delete your account in the app or email destek@dijitalasistan.app with the topic “Privacy”.

also.device: The app on your phone notices you're signed out the next time it opens and clears the data on the device. You can also uninstall the app.

duration.title: How long does it take?
duration.body: Your request is processed right after verification and usually completes within 24 hours; the legal maximum is 30 days. We email you when the account deletion is complete.
duration.backups: Copies in backups are deleted by the backup cycle within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and are kept only for disaster recovery until then.
duration.backupsUnset: Copies in backups are deleted by the backup cycle and are kept only for disaster recovery until then.

kept.title: What may be kept?
kept.body: To show that we carried out the request, a deletion record (reference, request and completion times, an irreversible digest of the email address) is kept for 3 years. In security audit logs your identity becomes an irreversible digest. Aggregate statistics that don't identify you are not deleted. Purchase records are kept by Apple and Google.

help.title: Having trouble?
help.relay: If you signed in with Apple and hid your email, your address ends in …@privaterelay.appleid.com; on iPhone you can see it in Settings › [your name] › Sign-In & Security › Sign in with Apple › Dijital Asistan.
help.noAccess: If you can't access your email, write to us through the <support>support form</support> with the topic “Privacy”, or send your request in writing; we verify your identity another way and process it.
